text: No lineup. Very efficient and professional staff.

This morning (June 5th, 2026) I had the opportunity to visit the dentist... The dentist who provided the check-up and tartar removal was the nicest... Very friendly, explained everything in detail, and gave excellent advice on how to improve and maintain oral hygiene. I was very impressed. The dentist has truly outstanding professional ethics. However, I would like to see the clinic increase its capacity to serve 7 or 8 patients per day instead of the usual 5. Sometimes I come and am disappointed because the queue is full.
If you go on a weekday, the doctor is always there, which is great. It's also convenient as it's close to home.

An older female dentist with thin, arched eyebrows provides terrible service. I took my daughter to have a tooth extracted twice, but each time she had the same tooth filled. She was rude and didn't listen when my daughter said it hurt. She just did whatever she wanted, complaining about the patient and speaking disrespectfully. During the consultation, I specifically requested extraction, but she did something completely different when I went for the extraction. Terrible experience.
The staff provided excellent service, and the doctor was lovely and friendly. Please maintain this standard of service. Thank you very much.

I was very impressed! Usually, at government hospitals, the service isn't great or they might not be attentive, but this place was excellent. Everyone was kind and caring. I highly recommend this hospital for both contraceptive injections and implants. I especially commend Dr. Bhima; he was so attentive, gave detailed advice, and the procedures were practically free – only a small fee, the rest was free! Even though it was free, the doctor treated me so well, both in his speech and the procedures themselves. The nurses, especially the one at the checkout counter, were all wonderful. Everyone was kind and caring. Simply outstanding! 👍🏻❤️
I came to have my wound cleaned. The male nurse cleaned the wound very carefully.

After an accident, I used my insurance to get my wound treated at a private hospital for the first 5-6 days. They cleaned and dressed the wound, which took about 40-50 minutes. They were careful and gently cleaned the wound, even though it was still fresh and not very painful. I could feel their attention to detail. Private hospitals use a different approach; they gently pull the bandage open, pour saline solution, and carefully apply dressing. However, the health center I went to did the complete opposite of the private hospital. I really noticed the difference.
The first time I went to the health center, they rushed and tidied the wound in less than 10 minutes. I could feel the difference compared to the private hospital, and they were very heavy-handed. Even on subsequent visits, the wound was very painful. I can't imagine how much pain I would have experienced on the first day if I had gone there. I hope they improve their approach. Just having an accident can be painful enough. Put yourself in my shoes. I want them to be more attentive and not rush through the treatment; treat each case individually.

I had a vaccination appointment scheduled via the Paotang app for August 11, 2024, at 1:00 PM. There was no confirmation call or option to change the appointment date because it turned out to be a public holiday. This is unlike other health centers that don't answer calls. The QR code provided on the page is blurry and unusable. The page doesn't announce special holidays or public holidays like other health centers. The system automatically selected the appointment date. I understand it was probably scheduled before the additional holiday announcement, but why didn't they check the system first? The long closure caused me to miss the vaccination opportunity, and I can't access the Paotang app to change the appointment date.

Your clinic opens at 8 AM but says you have to get a queue card early in the morning. How would anyone who doesn't know know that you have to go as early as 5:30 AM to wait for a queue card? This is crazy. You should post it on the map so patients know where to go. Don't just say it opens at 8 AM and not say anything at all. This is ridiculous. This kind of work is really terrible. You should post that the clinic opens at 8:00 AM and you have to wait to get a queue card at 5:30 AM. If you wait to get a queue card at 6:30 PM, an elderly person with no clue will know. They've already arrived. What should they do if they walk in?

The restroom had no toilet paper. I was so confused; what kind of restroom doesn't have toilet paper? I politely asked the staff because the toilet seat was dirty, but they didn't help at all. They just said, "Yes, there's no toilet paper in the restroom." I asked where I could get some, and they said there wasn't any either, and I had to bring my own, then walked away as if they didn't care. I was so confused. Then, when I talked to the administrative office, they said there wasn't any either, but when I mentioned the dirty seat, they gave me some toilet paper! 😀 Are we living in an era where even toilet paper is stingy?

This was my first time using their services. The staff and nurses were very friendly, polite, and kind. The doctor was also kind. Most of the patients were elderly, but the staff were never rude. I wish provincial government hospitals were like this too. 🩵

Additional suggestion: I wish the cashier staff would speak louder 😂 or even use a microphone.

I wanted to review my dental visit, hoping it will be helpful for first-time visitors.
First of all, the dental staff were all lovely and provided excellent service. I highly commend them!
1. For those who want free dental treatment, you can use your National Health Insurance (NHI) card. People from outside Bangkok can easily transfer their NHI to Bangkok themselves. Just search on Google. Once transferred to Bangkok, you can use your NHI anywhere.
2. The dental clinic has two sessions: morning and afternoon. They accept 5 patients per session, so expect a long wait.
- For the morning session, you can book an online appointment (I can't attach a picture, so try checking at the center) or walk-ins before 8:30 AM. I recommend arriving by 6:00 AM.
- For the afternoon session, I recommend walk-ins only. Staff will set up a queue system at 3:45 PM. I recommend arriving before 3:45 PM because people will already be waiting. If you arrive late, they won't accept more patients.
——————
Additional information: For general illnesses, there's an evening session opening at 4:00 PM. You can arrive by 3:30 PM. There are staff available to provide guidance.

The finance staff member seemed irritated early in the morning. People who don't come here often didn't know where to go next. I asked twice, but she wouldn't say anything. Her face clearly showed she was annoyed. Even with a mask on, her eyebrows were furrowed in a knot. She just pointed without speaking. This is how civil servants treat the public. How can people not criticize the government?
This was my first visit, and all the staff and dentists were lovely. The service was excellent, and everyone spoke politely. I was very impressed.

An employee at the center, "Orasa Srijui," nicknamed Noi, rented a room in Soi Pracha Rat Bamphen 9 and left it in a mess (clear photographic evidence exists). However, this employee refuses to admit the truth and has continuously posted …
The staff were very helpful and the doctor was very friendly and explained everything clearly. I highly recommend this place!

I transferred my rights from Din Daeng, but I was impressed with the service. The young and lovely doctors and nurses, along with the nurses, provided excellent, fast service. The nurses in the blood draw room were skilled and able to quickly draw veins from obese people's arms.

I came here and went home early. I'm glad I got treatment here.

text: I went for a vaccination; the service was quick. But in the parking lot, even though I was parked near the security guard's seat, a crazy person stuck chewing gum on my car's windshield. It was parked in a well-lit corner near the entrance/exit. Do they dispense medication for mentally ill people here? Why would people come here to get their medication?

I called because I have COVID, but they hung up on me. I called the complaints unit and they said the Department of Public Health would contact me, but it's been 8 PM and there's still no sign of them. I called again and got through, but they hung up on me twice.
If they don't have medicine or anything, they should at least answer the phone and let me know.
